utterance: What time does the pharmacy close today?
note: direct question — agent should take the floor (reach SPEAK)

utterance: Can you add milk and eggs to my shopping list?

note: listener backchannel — agent should stay LISTEN, not grab the floor

utterance: So given all that, what would you recommend I do next?
note: question after a pause — agent should respond
non-terminal barge-in during agent speech — agent should HOLD SPEAK (interruption avoidance)
backchannel over agent speech — should not yield

utterance: Wait, stop — actually cancel that order.
note: terminal barge-in / genuine interruption — agent SHOULD yield then act
